   \[
   x + y + z = 96
   \]

   \[

   \[
   z = y - 40

\[
\text{lcm}(a, b) = \frac{a \cdot b}{\gcd(a, b)}
\]

Substituting \( a = n \) and \( b = 18 \), we have:

\[
\frac{n \cdot 18}{\gcd(n, 18)} = 180

\[
n = 10 \cdot \gcd(n, 18)

The GCD condition tells us:

\[
\gcd(n, 45) = 15

\[
n = 10 \cdot \gcd(n, 18)

\[
